limits: Supplied secondary compilation; original source PDFs and packaging photograph not independently rechecked.
DW-H5600 module 3516 is a cross-reference from S2, not printed in brochure S1; DW-H5600 and GBX-H5600/QW3586 are different, with no LCD/sensor/case-part interchangeability asserted.
AWG-M520UA-1EJR and abbreviated AWG-M520UA identify one collaboration, not two visual variants. Preserve 13.1 mm UA-specific and 15.3 mm base-model thickness claims separately.
BMS-500 cell codes SR927SW (cited product pages) versus SR927W (cited guide) remain an unresolved discrepancy.
Oceanus chart dimensions are family-level; do not copy finishes or infer modules for S-series / T6000. Six chart-only family labels are not additional exact color variants.
OCW-T2600-1A3JF weight approximately 90 g; supplied study notes retailer 91 g. Production counts or launch dates explicitly marked unverified stay unverified.
DW-290 chronology: 1219, then 1189, then 3231. DW-290G-9V carries the owner-confirmed 1219/1189 alternatives only; no evidence for DW-290G-1V follows.
DW-290 modern 3231 dimensions/functions do not establish vintage specifications. DW-285 -VS suffix meaning is not asserted.
The DW-285 study labels its pictures catalog-style recreations, not original Casio photography; no images are copied.
GBX-H5600 blood oxygen measurement is a wellness feature, not a medical-use claim; release dates may vary by market.
